payout_quote: Plus, boost your balance with a $300 sign-on bonus when you bundle with an Innovator Savings Account. Apply for an Innovator Business Checking and Innovator Savings account with promo code GB300 anytime between now and 9/30/2026 and meet the eligibility requirements below.
steps: Apply online for both an Innovator Business Checking account and an Innovator Savings account using promo code GB300 by September 30, 2026 (minimum $100 opening deposit).
Fund the Innovator Business Checking account with $2,500 or more AND the Innovator Savings account with $25,000 or more within 30 days of account opening.
Maintain an average daily balance of $2,500+ in checking and $25,000+ in savings throughout the Maintenance Period (day 31 through day 90 after account opening).
catches: Substantial parked cash required: $25,000+ in savings and $2,500+ in checking must sit idle for the 31-90-day maintenance period.
Promo code GB300 required at application; both accounts must be opened for the bundle.

Certain industries excluded (adult entertainment, gambling, illegal substances, virtual currency, weapons/firearms); must be 18+, U.S. citizen/permanent resident with verifiable U.S. address (territories ineligible).
Bonus is considered interest and reported on IRS Form 1099-INT (taxable) — per Grasshopper's published incentive terms.
Bonus payout timing after the maintenance period is not stated on the page; consult full terms/Master Service Agreement.
Offer expires 9/30/2026; Grasshopper reserves the right to modify or end the promotion.
biggest_catch: You must keep $25,000 in the savings account (and $2,500 in checking) untouched from day 31 to day 90 after opening. The $300 bonus arrives only after that maintenance period, and offer ends 9/30/2026.
eligibility: New Grasshopper Bank business clients; promo code GB300; open both Innovator Business Checking and Innovator Savings by 9/30/2026; excluded industries not eligible.
timing: Apply by 9/30/2026 with promo code GB300; fund both accounts within 30 days; maintain balances days 31-90 after opening; $300 sign-on bonus paid after the maintenance period (exact payout timing per full terms).
